title: Kelp Line — Warm Coastal Calm Foundation

logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon. Until the owner’s own exists: the name set as a wordmark in the display face, and its first letter as the favicon — no invented symbol to throw away later
logo.note: Until the owner’s own logo exists: the name set as a wordmark in Hedvig Letters Serif (src/components/site/Logo.tsx) and its first letter as the favicon (src/app/icon.svg).

typefaces.specs: Hedvig Letters Serif, Hedvig Letters Sans (Google Fonts)
typefaces.note: Loaded from Google Fonts through next/font.

finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words
finalCopy.note: Written in src/content/site.ts. Lines marked [P] are invented placeholders (place, names, counts, dates, prices, quotes) for the owner to confirm.
